title: Merkavah mystics' chariot practice on Yom Kippur
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Merkavah mystics' chariot practice on Yom Kippur, about ancient to present at Jewish mystical communities, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A researcher named Peter Levenda says on Jesse Michels's podcast that every year at Yom Kippur, the Jewish day of atonement, certain groups of Jewish mystics carry out a practice called "descending the chariot". This comes from Merkavah mysticism, an old Jewish tradition built around visions of God's heavenly chariot, and Levenda offers it as proof that such a visionary journey is possible.
